evidence.quote: A polar sun-synchronous orbit allows for consistent illumination of the oceans

criteria.reasoning: Recaps launch, orbit, ground station and benefit for bleaching. Appropriate and linked to body but brief, generic, and notes Vega E uncertainty without full implications.
Logical headings and executive summary present, but figures lack numbers/titles, tables poorly formatted, grammar errors, malformed refs, and prohibited Wikipedia used as design source.

technical_issues.issue: Semi-major axis 7171 km for 600 km altitude wrong; should be 6971 km. Inclination 87.79 deg not SSO retrograde; plot shows ~97.8 deg, text contradicts retrograde claim.
Kourou latitude quoted as 45.05 N; actual ~5.2 N. RAAN 27.33 deg justified as launch facility location is incorrect.
Mean access 580.8 s (~9.7 min), max 770 s (~12.8 min), so claim of almost twenty minutes average is false, overstating link by ~2x.

overall: Single-satellite GBR fluid-lensing mission with full segment coverage and STK evidence, but marred by orbit calculation errors, vague operations, poor referencing and missing design files.
